title: Rita NDE 6768
content: My father was on the Catholic church softball team. The game was held at the church. My brother (who is three years younger than I am) and I wandered off. We weren't too far from the game though. He climbed a tree and told me to climb up. So, I did and had to climb higher than him. I was about 17 to 20 feet high. I noticed a woman below seated on a bench and wearing a gold sweater. This was the last thing I saw before I reached out for a branch. I then fell on my back to the ground. This is where my experience begins. I appeared in another place, it is hard to explain, floating in a different universe with tall beings (10 ft.). They were angelic-like, not human-looking, and very kind. Then I was floating or flying in front of my father. He was running fast from the softball game, looking very scared. Then I'm now looking down and watching people huddling over me. I opened my eyes and the woman sitting on the bench threw her gold sweater around me. My parents rushed me to the hospital. Due to trauma to my brain, I couldn't remember my name, age or day. The doctor examined me and asked me questions about my fall, like how high and where I was. I answered them correctly. The doctor sent me home because he couldn't find anything wrong with me. On the way home, I told my brother that after my fall, I went to the circus and saw people on trapeze flying. It was so fun. He was surprised. Since then, I never mentioned the experience to anyone else until I was about 20 years old. I was coming home from work and started to watch Oprah. The show was about life after death. I didn't think anything about the incidence until I saw the drawings and pictures on the show. I called my brother to the room and asked him if he remembered what I told him about my fall. He said, 'Yes, you went to the circus.' Then I pointed to the TV and told him that's where I went. Now I hear many stories about NDE's and their physical traits that I have in common with. I always felt different from others and didn't know why. I rarely share my story with anyone, only with people who are losing a loved one. Or I will share with those who are about to pass over, but with those it is telepathically as I'm praying over them holding their hand.
